name: Kunafa bil Qeshta
description: Classic kunafa layered with creamy qeshta filling and golden syrup.
fullDescription: Our Kunafa bil Qeshta is a beloved Egyptian classic — crispy shredded wheat layered over a generous filling of silky qeshta (clotted cream), soaked in fragrant rose-water syrup and garnished with crushed pistachios. Made fresh daily in our kitchen. Serves 2–3.

name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
description: Rich triple-layer chocolate cake with silky fudge frosting.
fullDescription: A chocolate lover's dream. Three moist layers of dark chocolate sponge are stacked with generous swirls of fudge buttercream and finished with a glossy ganache drip. Perfect for birthdays or any celebration. Feeds 6–8 people. Please order 24 hours in advance.

name: Baklava Box (12 pcs)
description: Assorted baklava with pistachios, walnuts, and honey syrup.
fullDescription: A beautiful gift-ready box of 12 mixed baklava pieces. Each piece is hand-layered with ultra-thin phyllo pastry, filled with a choice of crushed pistachios or walnuts, and drenched in pure honey syrup. Varieties include classic diamond cuts, rolled baklava, and bird's nest shapes.

name: Plain Croissant
description: Buttery, flaky French-style croissant baked fresh every morning.
fullDescription: Our Plain Croissant is laminated with real butter through 27 layers to achieve the perfect honeycomb crumb and shatteringly crisp shell. Baked fresh each morning and best enjoyed warm. Pairs beautifully with jam or a hot drink.

name: Cheese Croissant
description: Flaky croissant filled with melted cheese, golden and irresistible.
fullDescription: A bakery favourite — our buttery croissant is filled with a blend of stretchy mozzarella and tangy white cheese, folded and baked until the pastry is deeply golden and the cheese is perfectly melted. Great as a breakfast item or quick snack.

name: Birthday Layer Cake
description: Custom celebration cake with vanilla sponge and buttercream frosting.
fullDescription: Mark every milestone with our celebration-quality Birthday Layer Cake. Four tall layers of light vanilla sponge are filled and frosted with smooth Swiss meringue buttercream, decorated with fresh flowers or sprinkles per your preference. Feeds 10–12. Custom messages available — order 48 hours ahead.

name: Chicken Shawarma Sandwich
description: Tender marinated chicken with garlic sauce, pickles, and pita.
fullDescription: Our Chicken Shawarma is marinated for 12 hours in a blend of cumin, coriander, turmeric, and garlic, then slow-roasted on a vertical spit. Served in a warm pita with creamy toum (garlic sauce), crunchy pickles, and fresh tomatoes. A fan favourite.

name: Grilled Kofta Meal
description: Juicy beef & lamb kofta skewers with rice and salad.
fullDescription: A hearty plate of four seasoned kofta skewers grilled over charcoal, served alongside fragrant Egyptian rice, a fresh tomato-cucumber salad, and warm flatbread. Made with a blend of minced beef and lamb seasoned with parsley, onion, and a house spice mix.

name: Cheese Feteer
description: Crispy Egyptian feteer meshaltet filled with cheese, baked to order.
fullDescription: Feteer Meshaltet is Egypt's original layered pastry — hand-stretched, folded with butter through countless thin layers, and baked until shatteringly crisp. This savoury version is filled generously with a blend of white cheese and mozzarella. Each feteer serves 2.

name: Mixed Grill Platter
description: Generous platter of kofta, shish tawook, and grilled vegetables.
fullDescription: Our Mixed Grill Platter is a feast for two — featuring two kofta skewers, two shish tawook (chicken) skewers, and a colourful selection of grilled peppers, onions, and tomatoes, served with garlic rice, fresh salad, and two flatbreads. Great for sharing.

name: Falafel Sandwich
description: Crispy falafel with tahini, tomato, and parsley in fresh bread.
fullDescription: Our Falafel is made from freshly ground chickpeas and fava beans, blended with herbs and spices and fried to a perfectly crispy golden exterior. Served in soft Egyptian bread with tahini sauce, sliced tomatoes, fresh parsley, and pickles. A classic street-food staple.

name: Om Ali
description: Egypt's iconic warm bread-pudding dessert with nuts and cream.
fullDescription: Om Ali is Egypt's most beloved warm dessert — layers of crispy croissant or puff pastry baked with sweetened milk, fresh cream, shredded coconut, and a generous handful of mixed nuts (almonds, pistachios, raisins). Served hot from the oven in an individual clay bowl.

name: Spinach Fatayer
description: Triangular savoury pastries filled with spiced spinach and onion.
fullDescription: Traditional Fatayer filled with a savory mixture of fresh spinach, caramelized onions, sumac, and lemon juice — seasoned to perfection and baked until the soft dough turns lightly golden. These triangle pastries are perfect as a snack or appetiser. Pack of 4 pieces.

name: Rice & Chicken Meal
description: Slow-roasted half chicken served with Egyptian rice and soup.
fullDescription: A complete, satisfying meal: a slow-roasted half chicken marinated in garlic, lemon, and spices, served alongside a generous portion of Egyptian rice with vermicelli, a cup of clear chicken soup, and a fresh side salad. Comfort food at its best.
